restartAtMs.description: Legacy/full restart is0. After explicit shortcuts-v1 skip ACK, the current approved segment may start at10000. URL renewal never authorizes seeking by itself.

Create.description: Both modes retain required licenseClass from Card05. PRESET additionally selects an exact set/version; server fixes all ten positions.

IntroCapability.description: GET capability is authoritative. EXAM: unanswered RESTART to0 re-arms only the current position after START on the fresh nonce; stored response including0 prevents it. SKIP checkpoint10000 does not re-arm; renewal/exact restart or skip retry does not reapply.

reactionAcknowledgement.description: Opaque server confirmation of the stored first reaction, bound to target/nonce. Read state to recover a lost reaction ACK. Do not derive, log or persist this value.
